profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, with revenue of $67,535,000,000 for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, and trades on public markets under the ticker IBM. The company's website, focused on its OpenPages product line, describes IBM OpenPages as a scalable, AI-powered governance, risk, and compliance platform available on any cloud or on-premises, offering modular components covering risk management, compliance, and internal audit functions. The site notes that IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment, and highlights a partnership with Citi to automate internal audit processes using AI and machine learning.

IBM's tracked AI products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, a full GRC platform with AI-specific modules covering risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and automated documentation; IBM watsonx.governance, which handles AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation, and includes EU AI Act accelerators; and IBM watsonx, described as an enterprise AI platform with capabilities including agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection that is model-agnostic. The site describes OpenPages as integrating with watsonx.ai or third-party AI models through an API-based architecture, and mentions an OpenPages MCP Server intended to allow AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects within governed automation frameworks.

IBM watsonx.governance was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026, according to the held facts. IBM files with the SEC under CIK 0000051143, and its most recent revenue figure was reported on a 10-K form.
